This Master Services Agreement is entered into by the parties below and governs all statements of work issued under it.

1. Limitation of Liability
Each party's aggregate liability arising under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages.

2. Indemnification
Each party shall indemnify and hold harmless the other party from and against third-party claims arising from the indemnifying party's breach of this Agreement.

3. Intellectual Property
The Provider retains ownership of all intellectual property in its pre-existing tools, methods and know-how. The Customer receives a non-exclusive licence to use the Deliverables as contemplated by this Agreement, and no assignment of intellectual property is made by this clause.

4. Confidentiality
Each party shall hold the other party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party for three (3) years following disclosure.

5. Term and Termination
This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until terminated. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, and either party may terminate for material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty (30) days.

6. Fees and Payment
The Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices Net 30 from the invoice date. Late amounts bear interest at 1.0% per month.

7. Data Protection
Each party shall process personal data in accordance with the Data Processing Addendum entered into by the parties. A party shall notify the other party of a personal data breach within 48 hours of discovery and shall maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures.

8. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, and the parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in Delaware.

9. Assignment
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, and any attempted assignment without consent is void.

In witness whereof, the parties have executed this Agreement.

The Processor shall implement technical and organisational security measures appropriate to the risk of the processing, and shall protect personal data in accordance with this Data Processing Addendum. The Processor shall notify the Controller within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.

2. Sub-processors
The Processor shall give the Controller at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any intended addition or replacement of a sub-processor, and the Controller may object in writing within thirty (30) days of that notice. The Processor shall not proceed with a change while a reasonable objection remains unresolved.

3. International Transfers
The Processor shall not transfer personal data to a third country except under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision covering the destination, and shall notify the Controller before any new transfer begins.

4. Audit Rights
The Controller, or its designated auditor, may audit the Processor's facilities, systems, and records relevant to the processing on at least thirty (30) days' written notice, no more than once per year absent a personal data breach.

5. Return and Deletion of Data
On termination or expiry of this Addendum, the Processor shall, at the Controller's choice, return all personal data to the Controller or securely delete it, and shall certify the deletion in writing; backup copies shall be deleted within thirty (30) days thereafter.

6. Confidentiality
Each party shall hold the other's Confidential Information in confidence for three (3) years from the date of disclosure.

1. Employment and At-Will Status
The Employee's employment is at will: the Employee's employment may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause, on thirty (30) days' written notice. If the Company terminates the employment without cause, the Employee will receive severance of four (4) months of base salary. Nothing in this letter guarantees employment for any period.

2. Compensation
The Employee's base salary is $240,000 per annum, payable in monthly instalments.

3. Restrictive Covenants
For twelve (12) months following the end of the Employee's employment, the Employee shall not be employed by a business that competes with the Company within the state in which the Employee was employed. The Employee also agrees not to solicit the Company's customers or employees for twelve (12) months following the end of employment.

4. Invention Assignment
The Employee hereby assigns to the Company all inventions conceived or reduced to practice in the course of the Employee's employment and relating to the Company's business. Inventions conceived before the employment are excluded from this assignment. No assignment is made of inventions developed entirely on the Employee's own time that do not relate to the Company's business.

5. Dispute Resolution
Any dispute arising out of the Employee's employment shall be resolved by binding arbitration, at either party's election, under a mutual arbitration agreement. Nothing in this section prevents either party from seeking injunctive relief in court, or from pursuing statutory claims that cannot lawfully be submitted to arbitration.

6. Confidentiality
Each party shall hold the other party's Confidential Information in confidence for three (3) years from the date of disclosure.

Compensation Schedule

Base salary: $240,000 per annum.
Severance on termination without cause: $60,000.
